## Why
The next lifecycle implementation needs observed hook sequences and visible outcomes so review converges on the incidents that actually confused the operator. Backlog item: F3.

## Evidence
- All c11 code citations below are on origin/main `0ff8887e5e`; upstream citations are on upstream/main `920ff39ff7`.
- c11: `Resources/bin/claude:207` injects six hooks with asynchronous PreToolUse. `CLI/c11.swift:17006` caches AskUserQuestion while `:17036` assumes a later Notification. `Resources/bin/codex:47` carries the legacy notify payload; `Sources/AgentModelDetection.swift:88` currently has prompt/agent/tool-result observations.
- Research: BACKLOG.md F3; report 01 Effort and risk; Fable §3 week 1; Astra §3 acceptance examples and §4 late-event counterexample; `docs/aar-c11-188-attention-loop.md:59` explains the missing empirical oracle.
- Upstream: #15173/#16257 late-event fixes and #6606 bypass behavior are reference incidents, not a substitute for c11 captures.

## Scope
In: sanitized, replayable real captures for Claude normal and bypass modes, Codex, Grok and OpenCode; incident provenance and expected marks. Out: J2 fold/store implementation, speculative signal parity, screen classification and independent fixes to the A1 attention bug batch.

## Approach
Record hook/source occurrence and arrival order, provider version, source SHA, exact session/tab attribution and visible state before/after each step. Separate raw observed behavior from the intended repaired projection. Keep structural tool names where needed, but remove prompt/tool bodies and private identifiers. Where a provider emits no signal, record absence/capability limits rather than fabricate an event. Derive controlled reorder/restart variants from named real captures and label those variants.

## Acceptance criteria
1. The corpus contains versioned tagged-build captures for all five requested modes/providers: Claude normal, Claude bypass, Codex, Grok and OpenCode, each with a replay recipe and expected observations.
2. Capture bypass AskUserQuestion and ExitPlanMode, late async PreToolUse after Stop, Esc interruption, restart while waiting, and tab B’s tool start while tab A waits. Every incident has source/arrival ordering and a visible-state oracle; list missing native signals explicitly.
3. Include the C11-189/GAF-13 child-completion case as an attribution regression: a child callback must not be treated as the root finishing.
4. A reviewer can replay normalized fixtures without provider/network access and compare their expected projections. A fixture manifest links each transformed record to the sanitized capture and distinguishes current bug behavior from the intended result.
5. Public fixture artifacts contain no user prompt or tool bodies, secrets, private account names or real conversation identifiers.

## Validation
Capture on an Atlas-built tagged app after F1 and record the real UI through bounded computer use; use a verified display and dismissal. Add a lightweight fixture reader/replay contract, not tests that grep source text. Replay is the oracle handed to J1/J2 and Feed; the capture job is not a 72-hour soak.

## Dependencies
Depends on F1 / C11-216 for the tagged capture route. Unlocks J1 and the attention/Feed workstream. Coordinate the sibling-clear/bypass cases with A1; the fixture ticket owns evidence only.

## Risks
Provider/version drift, missing native signals and accidental content disclosure can invalidate fixtures. Capture must not add blocking hooks or mutate tenant config. Keep recording overhead out of hot paths; no new product UI is expected. Apply docs/aar-c11-188-attention-loop.md: evaluate the named fixtures/questions, cap review/fix cycles at three, and escalate non-convergence instead of expanding the contract.

Size: S. Tier: P0. Doctrine check: optional observation and c11-owned storage only; no tenant configuration writes, automatic answers or trust broadening.

data.body: Amendment (run brief): capture the corpus from production c11 now, without waiting for an Atlas tagged build. Every capture records production version and build (c11 --version, c11 doctor --json). Any case that genuinely needs a tagged build is marked recapture on tagged build in the manifest.

Corpus is on draft PR https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/495 at ad7d761e328381972a4319eed80c6dbb96786e42. Captured from production c11 0.67.0 (131); doctor status mismatch, both CLIs that version. No app restart and no computer use.

Observed: bypass AskUserQuestion (PreToolUse and PermissionRequest). The after-ask oracle was working with no unread notice; waiting.entered arrived with the later permission_prompt Notification. Sibling Bash ran before that ask was waiting, so the clear is not proven by this run. ExitPlanMode was not emitted. Escape was sent after Stop. Two ctrl+c keystrokes left both unreads in place and did not emit SessionEnd within 4 seconds. Normal Bash then Stop still read working. Codex notify tee was installed and no payload arrived. Grok emitted no native hooks. OpenCode's per-process plugin emitted session events and no session.idle. App restart is marked recapture on tagged build and has no invented events. derived-late-pretool-after-stop is a labeled reorder of the real normal-mode Bash capture.

Reader: c11Tests/LifecycleFixtureCatalog.swift in c11LogicTests. swiftc -parse only. Tests were not run.

VERDICT: FAIL — C11-271 at ad7d761e328381972a4319eed80c6dbb96786e42 against 0ff8887e5e965400b01645ef40b85fd0b2605cf2.

Blocking

1. `c11Tests/Fixtures/lifecycle/manifest.json:38-51,54-88,91-107,126-141,198-213` — The named incident oracles are still absent. In the sibling case tab A was working before tab B's tool, so it cannot prove that B preserves A's existing wait. ExitPlanMode never fired. Esc arrived after Stop. Two Ctrl+C keys produced no SessionEnd, and the app itself was not restarted. The Codex child-completion case received zero notify callbacks or thread IDs, so it cannot regress GAF-13. These are candidly described as gaps, but the cases remain marked `observed` and, except app restart, have no recapture requirement. Smallest fix: obtain bounded captures of the missing incident edges and their before/after UI oracles, or mark each case as an explicit gap requiring recapture and keep this ticket open until its stated incident coverage exists. Do not synthesize missing events.

2. `c11Tests/Fixtures/lifecycle/normalized/codex-child-completion.json:5-82` and `captures/codex-child-completion.json:1-25` (also `normalized/opencode-session.json:5-82` versus its capture) — The normalized records introduce surface creation, metadata, and liveness events absent from the linked captures. The same happens for normal Claude and Grok. A reviewer cannot establish whether those `observed` edges were captured, imported from another source, or constructed. This breaks the manifest's capture-to-normalized provenance contract. Smallest fix: put the sanitized source events in each paired capture, with the same stable order/identity, or remove the unmatched normalized events and label any inference explicitly.

3. `c11Tests/LifecycleFixtureCatalog.swift:5-24,70-95,147-169` — The replay API retains only seq/source/name/toolName and reads expected marks from the fixture itself. It drops sanitized session and tab identity, event attributes, observed oracle state, and source/arrival timing. C11-273 therefore cannot replay the child/root or sibling-tab attribution cases, or compare a fold's per-step result to the observed oracle through this reader. The test only checks nonempty self-reported marks and one derived order; it exercises no projection behavior. The ask case even supplies `see-notes` as its intended mark (`normalized/claude-bypass-ask.json:232-235`). Smallest fix: expose the sanitized identity, payload, order/timing and oracle fields in the reader, define concrete expected marks, and add a behavioral replay assertion through the executable projection seam when available.

Non-blocking

- I scanned all 23 capture/normalized JSON files and the manifest for email addresses, UUIDs, home paths, common key formats, and raw prompt/tool bodies; I found no apparent private value. The catalog's `assertPublic` check covers only a few patterns, so it should remain a supplemental guard, not the disclosure review. The Swift file is in the `c11LogicTests` sources phase and not the app target; its reads are local.

Runtime proof still required

- On Atlas, run the exact-head `c11-logic` fixture test and C11-273's eventual behavioral fold tests. Capture the missing incidents on a tagged disposable app with source/arrival order and visible before/after state, including an in-flight Esc, an actual app restart, and a child Codex notify. This review ran no builds or tests on Hyperion; `swiftc -parse` in the owner comment is not execution proof.

C11-271 repair cycle 1. Head ece3cf255b598ba49c8f17993d72012f444caadf. Draft PR 495. Delta review against ad7d761e.

Observed on production c11 0.67.0 (131). The app was not restarted. Doctor status remains mismatch, same version on PATH and in the bundle.

- claude-bypass-ask: AskUserQuestion, then an oracle whose mark was waiting, one unread notification, and waiting.entered.
- claude-sibling-tool-while-waiting: that waiting oracle, then Bash PreToolUse on the other tab, then the ask oracle still waiting.
- claude-esc-interrupt: Bash PreToolUse, Escape sent before PostToolUse and before Stop. The after-escape oracle mark was working. Intended mark is idle.
- claude-session-end: SessionEnd while metadata for that tab still answered. The oracle mark was working. Intended mark is idle.

Gaps, recapture_required tagged-build, no events:

- claude-bypass-exit-plan: ExitPlanMode did not fire.
- codex-child-completion: the retry recorded no notify callback.
- app-restart-while-waiting: the app was not restarted.
- claude-restart-while-waiting: not an app restart and not the session-end case.

Provenance: each normalized event has the same id, order, source, name, session, tab, and time as the paired capture. Derived events are labeled derived-reorder and point at the normal-tool source event. The reader test checks that identity and the replay order. swiftc -parse succeeded. The c11-logic test was not run.

VERDICT: FAIL — C11-271 at ece3cf255b598ba49c8f17993d72012f444caadf against origin/main 0ff8887e5e965400b01645ef40b85fd0b2605cf2. Delta re-review of ad7d761e328381972a4319eed80c6dbb96786e42..ece3cf255b598ba49c8f17993d72012f444caadf.

Blocking

1. `c11Tests/LifecycleFixtureCatalog.swift:51-60,365-370` — The new sibling replay check accepts the named failure: if tab A's `after-sibling` oracle changes from `waiting`/one unread to `working`/zero unread, and `current.mark` changes with it, every assertion still passes. The helper only requires an oracle to exist after tab B's Bash; it does not require that oracle to belong to tab A or preserve tab A's wait. This leaves cycle 1's replay-behavior finding incomplete for the sibling-clear incident. Smallest fix: require the after oracle to have the before oracle's tab, `waiting` mark, and preserved unread count in the replay assertion; compare that result to the concrete expected mark.

2. `c11Tests/Fixtures/lifecycle/captures/claude-bypass-ask.json:179-214` (mirrored at `normalized/claude-bypass-ask.json:177-212`) — The new observed capture says `waiting.entered` is arrival sequence 10 at 02:59:56.807 / 10,983 ms, then `ask-is-waiting` is sequence 11 at 02:59:56.000 / 10,176 ms. The oracle predates the event it is ordered after by 807 ms. A replay consumer cannot tell which ordering is observed, and the test only checks that some `t_ms` is positive. This is a delta-introduced contradiction in the required source/arrival timing. Smallest fix: restore the oracle's actual capture time if available; otherwise mark its precise time/order as unknown or inferred and avoid asserting an observed order that the record contradicts.

Non-blocking

- Cycle 1's other incident claims are now supported or labeled honestly: bypass ask, sibling tool, in-flight Esc, and clean SessionEnd have capture oracles; ExitPlanMode, both restart variants, and Codex child completion have empty events, `origin: gap`, and `recapture_required: tagged-build`. The derived late PreToolUse case is labeled as a reorder.
- All 12 normalized event lists exactly match their paired capture event lists, including identity and attributes. The reader now exposes session/tab identity, attributes, sequence, timestamps, and observed oracle fields. Expected marks are concrete. The changed fixture JSON disclosure scan found no apparent emails, home paths, UUIDs, common key formats, real session tokens, or raw prompt/tool bodies.

Runtime proof still required

- On Atlas, run the exact-head `c11-logic` fixture test; no builds or tests were run on Hyperion. A tagged disposable c11 app must recapture ExitPlanMode, an actual restart while waiting, and a Codex child notify with distinct root/child thread IDs, with source/arrival order and visible before/after oracles. Keep this ticket open until the named incident coverage exists. The production socket-only captures do not establish the required tagged-build UI proof.

VERDICT: PASS — C11-271 at 27ebd59619d09a916d1412fd8527b2aee96c71b7 against origin/main 0ff8887e5e965400b01645ef40b85fd0b2605cf2. Final delta review of ece3cf255b598ba49c8f17993d72012f444caadf..27ebd59619d09a916d1412fd8527b2aee96c71b7.

Blocking

None.

Non-blocking

- The cycle-2 sibling finding is fixed at `c11Tests/LifecycleFixtureCatalog.swift:51-63,368-376`. The replay requires the after oracle to belong to the ask tab, remain waiting, and retain its unread count. Changing tab A's after mark to working makes the predicate and expected-mark assertion fail; changing its unread count also fails.
- The cycle-2 bypass-ask timing contradiction is fixed in both `captures/claude-bypass-ask.json:161-215` and its normalized pair. The oracle is sequence 9 at 10,176 ms; the later liveness and waiting events are sequences 10–11 at 10,983 ms. The capture labels the cross-source time order unknown. The paired event arrays match exactly.
- The disclosure scan of all three changed files found no apparent email, home path, UUID, secret format, raw prompt/tool body, or real conversation identifier. The only token-pattern match is the literal `toolu_` in the Swift privacy guard. Both changed JSON files parse, and `git diff --check` is clean.

Runtime proof still required

- No build or tests were run on Hyperion. Atlas must run the exact-head `c11-logic` fixture test. The tagged-build recaptures for ExitPlanMode, a real restart while waiting, and a Codex child notify with distinct root/child IDs and visible oracles remain recorded build-mode residuals before landing; this final delta review does not treat those prior gaps as blocking findings.

Review cycle 3 PASS at 27ebd59619d09a916d1412fd8527b2aee96c71b7 (ev_01M3XAH5WH5MND5RECGAHPHW73). Not landing yet: planning mode. Before merge: exact-head c11-logic fixture test on Atlas (build mode), CI green, then Merge Captain. Tagged-build recapture gaps (ExitPlanMode, real restart while waiting, Codex child notify) remain open on this ticket for build mode.
